learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore the magical world of naming words and discover the different types of nouns around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A noun is a special naming word! It is the name of absolutely anything: a person, a beautiful place, a cute animal, or an everyday thing.
Common nouns name everyday things like 'boy' or 'city'. Proper nouns are super special names like 'Rahul' or 'Delhi' and they always start with a Capital Letter!
When we have a whole group or team of things, we use a single special word for them! A 'flock' of birds or a 'bunch' of sweet grapes are collective nouns.
These are invisible nouns! Abstract nouns name feelings, ideas, or qualities that we cannot touch or see, like 'happiness', 'bravery', or 'friendship'.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 The Room Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your room right now. Write down 3 Common Nouns you can see (like 'bed' or 'book') and 2 Proper Nouns (like your favorite toy's brand name or a book title)!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nouns are naming words for people, places, animals, and things.
⭐ Proper nouns are special names and always start with a capital letter.
⭐ Collective nouns name a group, and Abstract nouns name feelings or ideas!
